data.current_description: Copy the setup of another event of the same brand, usually the previous edition, into this event, such as its stages, departments and rota. The copy runs in the background: the answer is 202 while it is queued or running, with the run in the body and its address in the Location header. Find the event to copy from with listSetupCopySources, and show the person what will change with previewSetupCopy first. GET that address until the status is done, partly_done or failed. The brand needs the Event Management feature, and you need the owner, admin or producer role on both events. Send Accept: application/vnd.api+json.
data.description_suggestion: Start a background job to copy setup elements (stages, departments, rota, etc.) from a source event of the same brand into this event. Requires source_event_id in the request body and a Bearer token with owner, admin, or producer role on both events. The brand must have the Event Management feature enabled. Returns 202 Accepted while the copy is queued or running, with the run object in the response body and its polling address in the Location header. Poll that address with GET requests until status is done, partly_done, or failed. Use listSetupCopySources to find the source event and previewSetupCopy to show the person what will change before starting the copy. Send Accept: application/vnd.api+json.
